# Text Mask Zoom

**Wipe › Shape Mask** · v1.0.0 · 48 frames at 30 fps (24–90)

A word appears with the new scene inside its letters, then zooms through one letter until the new scene fills the frame.

[Preview video](https://github.com/GTKottman/remotion-transitions/releases/download/media/text-mask@1.0.0.mp4)

## Where it is used

- Title reveals
- Branded openers
- Chapter titles

## Use it

```tsx
import { linearTiming, TransitionSeries } from '@remotion/transitions';
import { toPresentation } from './src/core';
import textMask from './transitions/03-wipe/shape-mask/text-mask';

<TransitionSeries.Transition
  presentation={toPresentation(textMask, { /* params */ })}
  timing={linearTiming({ durationInFrames: 48 })}
/>
```

Use `linearTiming`: the transition applies its own easing.

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Default | Range | What it does |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `text` | string | `"NEXT"` |  | The word that reveals the new scene. |
| `focus` | number | `0.5` | 0–1 | Point of the word the zoom heads into, across its width (0..1). |
| `background` | color | `"#111111"` |  | Colour around the word before it fills the frame. |
